shared_call_cost_assignment: split equally when both routes benefit; route-specific calls charged to their route; all witnesses included
selection_rule: First six distinct relevant B2C opportunities with traceable route evidence, not already registered; freeze A before volume measurement; freeze B after discovery but before qualification. Record exclusions and any cross-route duplicate. No replacement of candidates after a disappointing measurement. No quota of PASS. If six cannot be found inside the cap, report missing slots rather than relabel another source.
routing_limit: The routes have different information at entry. This is a small operational comparison, not a causal or blinded experiment.
depth_rule: Measure cluster and price first; early stop for a reliably insufficient measured scope. Missing scope or conflicting evidence => REVIEW_PREQUALIFICATION. No supplier deep research without PASS. No samples, Ads or GMC actions.
outputs: six ideas per route where possible
addressable cluster with exclusions and uncertainty
review of a few STOPs with first verdict hidden from local second-pass worksheet
evaluation: dossiers with evidence sufficient for next action
candidate_data_note: No new production schemas, scoring weights or threshold changes; experiment artifacts only.
